tests: Six sanitized materials and original demo project
Seven recorded query top-five rankings and exact cosines
Free text searches metadata and authored context without a semantic claim
An empty query never selects an undefined preset alias
Source intervals validate order and source duration
Sourced note preserves literal text, author and interval
Decision resolution requires and preserves a rationale
Board cards move by explicit lane and retain their source
Human edits create an immutable child pitch version
Recorded AI draft retains provenance and exact generated fields
Pitch reading export escapes untrusted authored strings
JSON backup round-trip excludes unsafe source URLs and file blobs
Saved changes survive a fresh runtime at the same repository path
All rendered routes have one main/heading, safe text and nested-path links
Static entry files, relative assets, native input ownership and trusted fonts
scope: DOM-free source/controller/data/render-contract checks. Not browser media, IndexedDB, download, visual layout or assistive-technology acceptance.
